name: Valid Parentheses
description: Checks if a string of brackets is valid: every open bracket has a matching close bracket in the correct order. Uses a stack.
aim: Verify balanced brackets using a stack: push open brackets, pop+match for close brackets, valid if stack empty at end.
howItWorks: For each character: if opening bracket → push
If closing bracket → check if stack top matches
If no match or empty stack: INVALID
After processing: if stack empty → VALID

complexity.spaceDescription: Stack holds at most n/2 elements

alternatives: Counter approach — only works for single bracket type
